body_markdown:
HOUSTON, Sept. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Evolution Petroleum Corporation (NYSE American: EPM) ("Evolution" or the "Company") today announced that members of its management team are scheduled to participate in three upcoming virtual investor conferences hosted by Water Tower Research, Sidoti & Company, and Noble Capital Markets.


**WTR Virtual Insights Conference | September 22 – 23, 2026**


Management will participate in a fireside chat on Tuesday, September 22, at 8:30 AM CT in Track B, and host one-on-one meetings on Wednesday, September 23. Investors can register for this free event, submit questions for the Company, and request one-on-one meetings on the event registration platform[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=D7Azo4i7ef6kma88vIcmIA5kciMVINxr5-R8bdaQkkjBrP7g737qpspFbqqav4nYFY0hpbojYDccmC15YUbFM5rDCBHJ410WcjLI-Pl1WLwQxkj9pQ3WhNFEGdiJCn47ugUYDMdIUXnNMt4yxodRow==) . Investors can also send meeting requests directly to[events@watertowerresearch.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=gJ2o4tQ1lay_GrHqd0TlajRgNMasshA9_mUR8VCbfBJVDPX0hELMGTPWCuNYsvIi65F1Ti6tJVdYbhTYoow2GMBH_G_lZsbNpdO6KtlvcsoB02AQxXmySq-xV_6d3VOn) .


**Sidoti Small-Cap Virtual Conference | September 24, 2026**


Management will present and host virtual one-on-one meetings with investors on Thursday, September 24, 2026. The Company's presentation will begin at 11:15 AM CT in Track 2 and can be accessed live here. Registration is free. To register for the presentation or one-on-ones, visit[www.sidoti.com/events](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mv11ycuFDGaZ4I584U4mXBFR4FlK6T5JcDvwAoPsBZ-tAKOx_LM8GUVk-BJyNXviyFgy8Kyp1rHTVLSAci-vnB3-y523C3-yG713AvsQjdBnAY-aCLZALBBrHUv5hfQfsUXX_rmT0C4Cxo5mVJERzRsGLxhoxRr8_QyzyGoAFZdtwNGwOdk6vhPylDgCfMUNWMITSNjRJ7TWMLFjFwfn9g==) .


**Noble Capital Markets Emerging Growth Virtual Equity Conference | October 1 – 2, 2026**


Management is scheduled to present on Thursday, October 1, 2026, at 11:00 AM CT in Track 1, and host one-on-one meetings with investors that day. Investors can register on Noble's website at[www.nobleconference.com/virtual](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=3VxQYo3aLdEWeVClRJryUMsO1AwqPfPFmbD4_MCOwR4QYPqRbg6x5HaRJg8YwIyLpvNaFXQfU3u2fltShCq9B79OpspT_oSvYQmLdwhh1Uau-KSQoaxc3TOl1gdgqHvbV4E9JJWSjNfgzQsZa5SaACH5zs-4qxI_q9PvNBHLyXdO7zl84V_S6xLKlwlAmv5Qm4jyEruih-rkTct1vAcanA==) .[Channelchek](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=9leybABtPesOF7odS8vZtPxYCUVAcjIckTDVrO9Y7WyLd6YrEUsfRdzLtq_n8-i2G8abCi7afbQg3wHCemJ0gaZrR-sXiHy0ByIuQ49MepM=) will host replays of the presentation and Q&A sessions online for investors to view, free of charge.


To request a meeting with Evolution's management team during the conferences, please contact your conference representative or Evolution's investor relations team at[ir@evolutionpetroleum.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=hHXKSaZPEaB1-IFewMl1OnW7-JhgJHFqkdPD2UD9PnwygOA0V35-ukpd_nDIInAGPIQ1v2KISuaddbP4rjsQxtUN1E-RcPM_vs00kzf0Gx7wq47_isHZKQrjyuT41zG8) . After each event, replays of the Company's presentations will be listed in the investor relations section of its website at[www.ir.evolutionpetroleum.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=zJMkIQ7fO263zzNUHLzdSAa0_uT73dBq-HXCGe9CZnf36A8CJ3b1W5JHx-eaxZJYlPyLHtT-aWdSWyTEZS8IOijn7IYYU74c6pIzSjJR3m0hlOKKsLWl8udUkzb0MxXZm5PtCxzaPhNtpJzpBnZ6eJlqdhbuknwIOa0XcqQZv0k=) .


**About Evolution Petroleum**


Evolution Petroleum Corporation is an independent energy company focused on maximizing total shareholder returns through the ownership of and investment in working and royalty interests in onshore oil and natural gas properties in the U.S. The Company aims to build and maintain a diversified portfolio of long-life oil and natural gas properties through acquisitions, selective development opportunities, production enhancements, and other exploitation efforts. Visit[www.evolutionpetroleum.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=-_TF5QiLWokTBwst_7dpg1HHar0nqS7W_ZKPk2II66LpyzVZhp8C8W0YADkcRGljAbyFx_j2IM8NJjlPHO6tNw4OAk8eB1NAoBTSe3-6jgmsz2IXlV2M3AQRkhdxIQaf) for more information.
